official.deadline_note: Applications opened on 27 July 2026 and close on 1 October 2027, for study commencing in 2027 or 2028 at a Curtin Western Australian campus. Curtin reserves the right to cease offering the scholarship if all places are filled before the closing date.
official.application_cycle: For study commencing 2027 or 2028 at a Curtin Western Australian campus
official.status_note: The scholarship page shows Status: Open with applications open 27/07/2026 and applications closing 1/10/2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Provides 40% of the tuition fee of the course, credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree course OR a maximum of 2 years for a Master's degree by coursework (the scholarship term), as a tuition fee credit against all units enrolled within the course within the scholarship term. The page states it only covers tuition fees and does not cover any other international student expense.
benefits: 40% off the tuition fee of the course for the duration of the course
Credit applied to the recipient's fee account after census date of the first study period
Automatic assessment of all qualifying Curtin course applications, with a supplementary letter issued alongside the Letter of Offer
eligibility: International, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian
Enrolled in a Curtin undergraduate degree course OR a Master degree by coursework
Studying at a Curtin Western Australian (WA) campus commencing in 2027 or 2028

Not enrolled in a Not-for-Degree Exchange or Study Abroad program, a campus transfer from a Curtin global campus, or a recognised joint program at a Curtin Transnational Partner Location outside Australia
Not enrolled in one of the excluded courses

Maintain an academic status of 'Good Standing' and a minimum CWA of 70% from the second study period onwards, in every study period across the scholarship term
Maintain full-time enrolment in each study period; underloading does not extend the scholarship term
Not be on Leave of Absence during the scholarship term, since those study periods still count towards the term
Not be Withdrawn or AWOL from Curtin
Not receive, hold or be awarded any other Curtin or Australian government scholarship while in receipt of this scholarship
Pay the full Deposit amount set out in the Letter of Offer for the first study period to accept the scholarship offer
Accept the Letter of Offer and enrol in the course by the specified date
Abide by Curtin's policies and procedures, Student Charter, and not be found guilty of serious misconduct

Tuition fees only - the page states it does not cover any other international student expense

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 40% tuition discount rather than a living grant, so treat it as a fee reduction and fund your own flights, accommodation and day-to-day costs. You do not apply for it separately: apply to Curtin through a registered agent or directly to Curtin online, and Global Admissions automatically assesses qualifying applications, confirming success by supplementary letter with your Letter of Offer. The bar is a Course-Weighted Average of 95% or equivalent in your most recent eligible study, and Curtin decides equivalence itself, so a strong but slightly lower average is unlikely to qualify. Check the excluded course list before you commit to a programme, because medicine, nursing, paramedicine, oral health therapy, dietetics, occupational therapy, social work and the psychology and taxation masters are all carved out.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international fee-paying students, not sponsored, with a 95% CWA or equivalent, entering a non-excluded Curtin undergraduate or coursework Master's at a Western Australian campus in 2027 or 2028.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your intended course is not on the excluded undergraduate or postgraduate coursework lists
Confirm your most recent course of study gives you a CWA of 95% or equivalent, and that Curtin will accept that qualification as equivalent
Confirm you are not sponsored and will study at a Curtin Western Australian campus in 2027 or 2028, not via exchange, study abroad, a global-campus transfer or a transnational partner program
Arrange the full Deposit amount from your Letter of Offer, since paying it is how you accept the scholarship offer
Plan full-time enrolment from your first study period and avoid Leave of Absence, because underloading and LoA do not extend the scholarship term
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling in an excluded course, which removes eligibility even with a 95% average
Being sponsored, or coming through exchange, study abroad, a global campus transfer or a transnational partner program, all of which are excluded
Holding any other Curtin or Australian government scholarship, which Curtin states will revoke this one
Deferring studies beyond the study period and year offered, which forfeits the award
Failing to pay the full Deposit or to accept and enrol by the date specified in the Letter of Offer
Dropping below Good Standing or a 70% CWA from the second study period onwards, or withdrawing/going AWOL, all of which can trigger revocation and leave you liable for outstanding tuition
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Everything except 40% of tuition. Living costs, accommodation, flights, Overseas Student Health Cover and general living expenses in Perth are self-funded, and Curtin states the scholarship covers no other international student expense.
document_audit: The scholarship page publishes no document list, so follow Curtin's standard international application document requirements and confirm anything unusual with Global Curtin
Your Letter of Offer and its Deposit deadline are the acceptance documents for this scholarship, so diarise the payment date immediately
Academic transcripts must evidence the 95% CWA claim, because the assessment is automatic and there is no opportunity to explain a borderline average
alerts: Curtin can stop offering the scholarship at any time once all places are filled, so an application lodged late in the window is riskier than it looks
The credit lands on your fee account after census date of the first study period, so budget for the first payment before the credit appears
The scholarship cannot be withdrawn or refunded in cash and cannot be transferred outside Western Australia or to another university
The 95% CWA threshold and the excluded course list can change without notice
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to Curtin through a registered education agent or directly online, let Global Admissions assess automatically, then accept the Letter of Offer by paying the full Deposit and enrolling by the specified date to trigger the tuition credit.
